summary: Frontend-only regression of the three share enhancements (editable caption, Auto stats, shared X/WhatsApp/Copy row) on demo@roujaune.app in landscape 1280x900. ACHIEVEMENT share (fitness → digest-share) PASS: share-caption-input editable, share-caption-auto rewrites caption to '36 TSS this week — 3 rides · 0.5 hours · 15.6 km distance\nRidden on ROUJAUNE 🚴…', share-x/share-whatsapp/share-copy render, share-copy shows the 'Caption copied — paste it into any app 📋' notice, share-card-share (More…) + share-card-save present, IG story/feed buttons correctly absent on web, no red screen. SUMMARY share sheet (/summary → action-share) PASS: ride-share-sheet opens with an auto-populated caption '🚴 Alpe d'Huez ⏱ 1:00:00 📍 23.7 km ⛰ 1050 m ⚡ 248 W avg ❤️ 148 bpm 🔥 622 kcal #Roujaune'; ride-share-caption-input editable; ride-share-caption-auto restores the ride-stats caption; share-x/share-whatsapp/share-copy present; share-copy triggers 'Caption copied' notice; ride-share-more and ride-share-close present; IG buttons absent on web. SCENIC RECAP share (saved-destinations) NOT REACHABLE from a fresh demo session — the seeded demo rider has zero completed journeys (saved-empty state shown), so the JourneyRecapCard 'Share recap' button never renders and the ScenicRecapShareModal cannot be opened in the web preview. Code inspection confirms ScenicRecapShareModal wires the same components: CaptionEditor (testID=recap-caption + recap-caption-input + recap-caption-auto), SocialShareRow (share-x/whatsapp/copy + IG gated by Platform.OS!=='web'), recap-share (More…), recap-save, recap-close. One minor landscape-only design nit (see design_issues). No red-screen errors on any flow.

integration_issues.issue: Cannot exercise from a fresh demo login: demo@roujaune.app has no completed scenic journeys, so /saved-destinations renders the 'No journeys yet' empty state and no journey-share-* button is rendered. Modal wiring verified by code inspection only; recap-caption-input / recap-caption-auto / share-x / share-whatsapp / share-copy / recap-share / recap-save / recap-close testIDs are present in /app/frontend/src/components/ScenicRecapShareModal.tsx. Recommend either seeding at least one demo ScenicJourney for the demo rider, or verifying on device.

issues: On landscape web (1280x900) the bottom-sheet content (title, CaptionEditor, SocialShareRow, actions row) is left-aligned in a narrow ~360px column even though the sheet spans the full viewport width. CaptionEditor sets alignSelf:'stretch' + maxWidth:360, which overrides the sheet's alignItems:'center'. Result: on a wide viewport the caption box, X/WhatsApp/Copy row and More…/Done buttons all hug the left edge instead of centering. Not a functional bug and won't be visible on mobile, but worth wrapping the sheet body in a centered maxWidth container (or dropping alignSelf:'stretch' on the inner children) so landscape web looks intentional. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/RideShareSheet.tsx lines 28-49 + CaptionEditor.tsx line 45.

action_items: Optional: seed at least one completed ScenicJourney for demo@roujaune.app so ScenicRecapShareModal can be exercised end-to-end in the web preview (currently 'No journeys yet' blocks the runtime path — modal code is correct per inspection).

Optional (landscape polish only): center the RideShareSheet body on wide viewports — either wrap {CaptionEditor + SocialShareRow + actions} in a View with alignSelf:'center' + maxWidth:420, or change the inner children from alignSelf:'stretch' to alignSelf:'center'. Doesn't affect mobile.
critical_code_review_comments: SocialShareRow.tsx correctly hides Instagram Story + Instagram Feed buttons behind Platform.OS !== 'web' (lines 63-68); verified at runtime — both testIDs return count=0 in the web preview. shareX/shareWhatsApp/copyCaption fall through on web via direct Linking.openURL / Clipboard.setStringAsync without any canOpenURL gate, so no crash path.

CaptionEditor.tsx uses one shared testID prefix — the achievement modal passes 'share-caption' → renders share-caption-input + share-caption-auto; scenic recap passes 'recap-caption' → recap-caption-input + recap-caption-auto; summary sheet passes 'ride-share-caption' → ride-share-caption-input + ride-share-caption-auto. All three verified.

ShareCardModal.tsx Auto stats builder (lines 189-193) correctly composes '<title> — <val label>·… \nRidden on ROUJAUNE 🚴 · Your strongest ride is your own.' — verified live: '36 TSS this week — 3 rides · 0.5 hours · 15.6 km distance…'.

ScenicRecapShareModal.tsx Auto stats builder (lines 145-153) formats distance (km, 0/1 decimals), duration (h/m or min), elevation ('N m climb'); guards for null/NaN look correct — not runtime-verifiable in preview without a seeded journey.

RideShareSheet.tsx passes autoCaption=rideCaption(stats,route) from summary.tsx — initial caption already contains the ride numbers, so Auto stats currently just restores the same caption after an edit. Works as intended.
No red-screen / no critical console errors on any of the three flows. All 401s during boot are pre-auth API calls, expected.

success_rate.frontend: Achievement share: 100% verified live. Summary share sheet: 100% verified live. Scenic Recap share: code-verified only (empty demo dataset blocks live).

Achievement share triggers on /fitness: digest-share, streak-share, season-share (milestone-share not rendered for demo — its card only shows when data.milestones has entries). Summary share opens by hitting /summary directly then clicking [data-testid=action-share] — the last active workout is auto-loaded so the sheet works without completing a ride. Scenic Recap: /saved-destinations shows saved-empty for demo — seed a journey to test live.
